new_value: Fixed: removed the dead 'density_adaptive.json' entry from the test_vector_file_schema parametrize list (python/tests/test_vectors.py) with an explanatory comment. Root cause: the file never existed on any branch (git log --all empty) and the schema's density_adaptive_vector family (announce tier/interval/gradient fields) has no spec section and no implementation anywhere in py/rust/c — the bead's spec-02a-2a.9.2 guess points at a different family already covered by ccp13.json (10 boundary vectors, consumed by test_ccp13_adaptive_vectors.py + rust ccp13_vectors).
